title: Computer Science Foundations
description: A comprehensive self-study curriculum from basic computation theory to operating systems and algorithms.
targetAudience: Self-taught developers, university students, and career switchers

phases.name: Discrete Mathematics & Logic
phases.description: Master the mathematical underpinnings of computer systems and algorithms.
phases.projectMilestone: Implement a propositional logic theorem prover in code.

phases.name: Data Structures & Asymptotic Analysis
phases.description: Understand core structures and analyze computational time/memory efficiency.
skills: Arrays, Linked Lists, Stacks, and Queues
phases.projectMilestone: Build an in-memory key-value cache with collision resolution and TTL eviction.

phases.name: Computer Architecture & Operating Systems
phases.description: Learn how software instructs hardware and how modern kernels manage concurrency.
skills: Virtual Memory, Paging, and Page Faults
phases.projectMilestone: Write a multi-threaded HTTP server with POSIX sockets and thread pooling.

title: Modern AI & Machine Learning
description: A structured pathway covering statistical learning, neural architectures, and LLM systems engineering.
targetAudience: Developers looking to transition into applied ML and AI engineering

phases.name: Mathematical & Statistical Core
phases.description: The essential calculus, linear algebra, and probability for machine intelligence.
phases.projectMilestone: Build linear regression and logistic regression from scratch using pure NumPy.

phases.name: Deep Learning & Neural Networks
phases.description: Designing, training, and regularizing modern neural network architectures.
phases.projectMilestone: Train an end-to-end vision classifier and evaluate robustness with test augmentations.

phases.name: Transformers, LLMs & Retrieval Systems
phases.description: Applied engineering with foundation models, vector search, and agentic workflows.
phases.projectMilestone: Create an open-source domain-specific academic search engine with vector embeddings.
